Hello! I'm Dapeng, a CS PhD student at Tsinghua University, in the College of AI and the Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR). I'm advised by Prof. Yanyan Lan.

I work on AI for Science. I'm interested in how models and agents learn, reason, and discover — from self-evolving LLMs to scientific discoveries. My long-term goal is to build AI scientists.

Before this, I studied Mechanics & Aerospace Engineering at Tsinghua. I like following ideas across disciplines, and seeing where they lead. Say hello! :)
